description: This file implements the MediaPipeline class and related functions for media streaming, including state management, media source handling, and IPC communication within the Rialto client media framework.

classes.name: MediaPipeline
classes.description: Implementation of the media pipeline handling media source management, state updates, and IPC communication within the Rialto client.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media content of specified type with given MIME type and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the pipeline by ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback and resets state.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position if in a valid state.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window position and size.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Handles need data requests during buffering or playing states.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to the pipeline, handling encryption and frame writing.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Requests rendering of a frame.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the media volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Retrieves mute status.

methods.name: discardNeedDataRequest
methods.description: Discards a pending need data request by ID.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the media pipeline client.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates internal state based on network or playback state changes.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notifies client of playback state changes.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notifies client of position updates.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notifies client of network state changes.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Handles need media data requests from sources.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Updates application state and clears requests if not running.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notifies client of QoS information.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notifies client of buffer underflow events.
